inputs.name: trivy_version
inputs.description: Trivy release to install from GitHub. Change checksums with it.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, from the release's trivy_<version>_checksums.txt. Change these with trivy_version.

inputs.name: severity
inputs.description: Severities to report, from UNKNOWN, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH and CRITICAL.

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: Absolute paths to scan, each with a report of its own. The default is the host's whole root filesystem.

inputs.name: skip_dirs
inputs.description: Directories to leave out of the scan, as absolute paths or globs, such as network mounts or "/var/lib/containers".

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: When the scan timer runs, as a systemd OnCalendar expression such as "daily" or "Sun 03:00".

inputs.name: keep
inputs.description: Number of scans to keep under /var/lib/conn3x-trivy. Older ones are deleted after each scan.

inputs.name: run_now
inputs.description: Scan during the apply: on the first apply, and again whenever the scan's settings change. The first scan downloads Trivy's database.
